issues.detail: Spec S01-S02 describe 7-bit pc and 7-bit global history hashed by xor into 7-bit index; contract states this in state meaning but no rule explicitly defines index computation or PHT entry selection.
issues.spec_evidence: Build a gshare branch predictor with 7-bit pc and 7-bit global history, hashed (using xor) into a 7-bit index.

issues.detail: Spec S10 says training is told pc and branch history register value for the branch being trained; contract has train_history input but no rule explicitly states how train_history is used for PHT indexing.
issues.spec_evidence: When training for a branch is requested (train_valid = 1), the branch predictor is told the pc and branch history register value for the branch that is being trained, as well as the actual branch outcome and whether the branch was a misprediction (needing a pipeline flush).
